description: Speech to text with Whisper large v3 turbo: transcribe audio (mp3, wav, m4a, ogg, webm; up to 20 MB, about 20 minutes) from a URL or base64, or translate the speech into English. Returns the text, language, duration and timed segments. Costs USD 0.01 per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base); calls that fail are not charged.
